faqs.question: Where do I calculate inheritance?
faqs.answer: Tap the 'Inheritance' card on the Dashboard home screen or navigate to `/inheritance`. Tap 'Start Calculation' to select heirs and enter estate figures.

faqs.question: How do I calculate zakat?
faqs.answer: Tap the 'Zakat' card on the Dashboard or navigate to `/zakat`. Select your asset types (Cash, Gold, Stocks, Business), tap 'Next: Enter Details', input your values, and tap 'Calculate Zakat'.

faqs.question: How do I change my default Madhhab?
faqs.answer: Go to Profile tab (`/(tabs)/profile`) -> tap Settings gear icon -> select 'Madhhab Preference' and choose between Hanafi, Maliki, Shafi'i, Hanbali, or Ja'fari.

faqs.question: How do I export my calculation as a PDF?
faqs.answer: After completing an Inheritance or Zakat calculation, tap the 'Download PDF Report' button on the results screen. You can save or share the generated PDF report.

faqs.question: What features are included in MIZAN Premium?
faqs.answer: MIZAN Premium includes unlimited PDF report exports, detailed 5-Madhhab comparative breakdowns, priority AI Scholar consultations, and estate profile saving.

faqs.question: How do I ask the AI Assistant a question?
faqs.answer: Tap the 'AI Assistant' tab at the bottom of the screen (`/(tabs)/ai-assistant`). Type any question about Islamic finance or app features into the chat box and press send.

faqs.question: Where can I view my past calculations?
faqs.answer: Tap the 'History' tab in the bottom navigation bar (`/(tabs)/history`). You can filter past calculations by All, Inheritance, or Zakat.

faqs.question: Does MIZAN perform financial calculations using AI?
faqs.answer: No. All Islamic financial calculations (Mirath and Zakat) are calculated deterministically by MIZAN's offline Rule Engine. The AI Assistant only explains and references sources for verified outputs.
